default_budget: two compact entry blocks (Strategy + Alternative) with availability-gated explicit actions; no simulation tables by default

entry_points.alternative: EXPLORE ALTERNATIVE disclosure -> eligible-N + supported-compound form -> RUN COMPARISON (explicit)
entry_points.strategy: EXPLORE STRATEGY button (explicit cached compare, enabled only when available)

reference_semantics: compared with simulated no-intervention reference (strategy) / simulator-conditional comparison under a controlled intervention (counterfactual)
uncertainty_framing: simulation sampling uncertainty (paired MC intervals); never real-world confidence
